summary: PASS end-to-end on all new iteration-11 features. BACKEND (9/9 pytest against the public URL, /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py): (1) GET /api/tickers/quotes?symbols=AAPL,TSLA returns per-symbol {symbol,price,prevClose,change,changePct,currency} with numeric price>0 and numeric changePct; case-insensitive dedup (aapl,AAPL,AaPl -> 1 row 'AAPL'); empty symbols returns {results:[]}. (2) GET /api/tv/episodes?id=44458 returns {name,status,network,seasons,totalEpisodes,upcoming[],recent[]} with seasons=3 and totalEpisodes>0; invalid id=999999999 correctly returns 404 (not 500). (3) GET /api/teams/status?teams=MLB:NYY|NFL:CAR returns 2 rows with valid highlight enum, real display name + logo URL; malformed 'XXX:ZZZ' and 'NOCOLON' both return 200 with highlight='none' (no 500). (4) GET /api/tv/status?names=Ted%20Lasso now includes an integer 'id' field used by the episodes modal. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile viewport, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): App loads with header rendering — 'INFO WALL' title + settings-button + preview-button both operable and no crash; new-episode-badge is absent by default (correct — none of the tracked shows air today), which matches the spec. Toggle-all-sections expands correctly. SPORTS team-1-row (Yankees) shows pill 'Sep 27 vs BAL' and team-2-row (Panthers) shows pill 'Sep 27 @ CLE' — matches ESPN nextEvent data. TV SHOWS: tapping show-1-row (Shrinking) opens the episodes modal, which shows '3 seasons · 31 episodes' summary, network, UPCOMING/RECENT episode rows, and an episodes-imdb 'View on IMDb' link; episodes-close closes the modal. FINANCIAL TICKERS: stock-1 (AAPL) shows 'Apple Inc. · Equity' + price 341.07 ▲+1.53%; stock-2 (MSFT) shows 'Microsoft Corporation · Equity' + price 516.17 ▲+3.66%; typing 'ZZZZZ' into stock-3-input yields red 'Unknown symbol — blocked, won't show on the wall'. All flows working; no console errors — only pre-existing cosmetic warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents) that were flagged in iteration_10.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/tv/episodes: on any upstream exception (including TVmaze 404) the endpoint raises HTTPException 404. Good — matches spec that invalid id must NOT surface as 500.
server.py /api/teams/status: for missing colon or unknown league, returns early with default {highlight:'none'} — spec-compliant and safe (no 500 from ESPN 404s).
server.py _quote_one: dividing by prev to compute % is guarded with `and prev`. Safe against zero. Price cache TTL 60s is reasonable.
ShowRows EpisodesModal: uses `show.imdb` from ShowStatus (not from episodes endpoint) for the IMDb button — verified rendered.
index.tsx: new-episode-badge only mounts when newTodayCount>0; wrapped in Text, wired to setSectionOpen({tv:true}). Correct. Aria/testID present.
